purpose: Public, privacy-safe treatment inputs for the initial skillz first-visit and returning-user journey evaluations. Evaluator-only decisions and scoring criteria are intentionally stored outside the public repository.
rules: Do not substitute real user private data for these synthetic scenarios.
Treatment agents may receive this public fixture and the repository, but must not receive the private evaluator bundle.
Scenario identifiers are deliberately neutral and do not encode the expected decision class.
Record the exact repository commit, catalog state, host/model, and installation or handoff state used by each run.

user_evidence.recurring_pattern: The user repeatedly compares two or more agent configurations before rollout. They use a fixed task set plus holdout tasks that must not be used for tuning, define success metrics before the run, retain failed cases, enforce a cost ceiling, and want regressions surfaced instead of hidden inside an average score.
corrections: Do not tune on the holdout tasks.
Do not report only the average when a configuration regresses on an important task class.
Evaluation must not write to production systems unless the target is an explicitly isolated sandbox.
user_evidence.host: Google Agents CLI-compatible development host with shell access

user_evidence.recurring_pattern: The user repeatedly verifies web changes on desktop and mobile by exercising the real browser, collecting console and network failures, checking responsive behavior, and preserving screenshots or other visual evidence for product-critical regressions.
corrections: QA is read-only unless I separately authorize a fix.
A page loading successfully is not enough if console, network, or visual behavior is broken.
Do not claim a visual pass without actually inspecting rendered output.

user_evidence.recurring_pattern: Before a production data migration, the user requires a schema diff, a dry-run transformation on representative samples, record-count or checksum reconciliation, a human spot-check of user-visible migrated records, and a demonstrated rollback path. The workflow must keep PLANNED, DRY_RUN_VERIFIED, HUMAN_VERIFIED, APPROVED, and EXECUTED states distinct.
corrections: Never blur a successful dry run into permission to execute production writes.
Human spot-checking of user-visible records is mandatory before approval.
Production mutation requires explicit approval even when every deterministic check passes.
user_evidence.host: software-development agent host with database tooling
